#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check a routed board against the unrouted board it started from, with KiCad's own design-rule check.

Usage: boardcheck <routed.kicad_pcb> [--json out.json] [--keep graded.kicad_pcb]

Only tracks, arcs and through vias are taken from the routed file. They are copied onto a pristine copy
of the unrouted board, so nothing else in the routed file (footprints, pads, nets, zones, outline, rules)
can affect the result. Zones are refilled, KiCad's DRC is run with the board's own rules (the project
file and the rules file beside the pristine board), and each net is counted as good if it is fully
connected and none of its new copper is part of a rule violation.

KiCad stops listing one kind of violation after 199 entries (499 for clearance) and missing connections
after 499. A net is never counted good just because the list stopped:
  - violations cut short: the nets found bad so far are taken off the board and the rest is checked
    again, until the list is complete. What counts is then exactly what would count if only the
    surviving nets' copper had been handed in.
  - missing connections cut short: every net that has new copper and is not on the list is tested on
    its own with KiCad's connectivity engine.

The same script runs in the agent's environment (so the agent can check its own work) and in the
verifier.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
BASE_DIR = os.environ.get("BOARDCHECK_BASE", os.path.join(HERE, "base"))  # pristine unrouted board + project file
MAX_ITEMS = 60000

# Violations that count. Each is an "error" in KiCad's default severities and is about copper that a
# router places, including the length-matching rules in a board's rules file. Rules about silkscreen,
# courtyards and zone thermals do not count. Nor does the gap between the tracks of a differential pair,
# which KiCad takes from a net-class default that the designers' own boards do not always keep.
COUNTED = {
    "clearance", "shorting_items", "tracks_crossing", "track_width", "via_diameter", "annular_width",
    "drill_out_of_range", "hole_clearance", "hole_to_hole", "holes_co_located", "copper_edge_clearance",
    "items_not_allowed", "microvia_drill_out_of_range", "padstack", "track_angle", "track_segment_length",
    "via_dangling", "creepage", "connection_width", "copper_sliver", "solder_mask_bridge",
    "skew_out_of_range", "length_out_of_range",
}


MERGE = r"""
import json, re, sys, pcbnew
ESCAPES = {"dblquote": '"', "quote": "'", "lt": "<", "gt": ">", "backslash": "\\", "slash": "/", "bar": "|",
           "comma": ",", "colon": ":", "space": " ", "dollar": "$", "tab": "\t", "return": "\n", "brace": "{"}
def unescape(name):  # KiCad stores e.g. a '/' inside a label as {slash}; its reports print the plain character
    return re.sub(r"\{([a-z]+)\}", lambda m: ESCAPES.get(m.group(1), m.group(0)), name)
routed_path, base_pcb, out_path, owners_path, max_items, leave_off_path = sys.argv[1:7]
options = json.load(open(leave_off_path))
leave_off = set(options["leave_off"])  # nets whose copper is left off the board this round
free = set(options["free"])            # parts whose place is read from the routed file (place-and-route tasks)
base = pcbnew.LoadBoard(base_pcb)
routed = pcbnew.LoadBoard(routed_path)
problems, owners = [], {}
parts, off_board = {}, {}
if free:
    # Position, rotation and side of each free part come from the routed file, by reference. The part
    # itself, with its pads and nets, is the one on the pristine board.
    theirs = {}
    for fp in routed.GetFootprints():
        theirs.setdefault(fp.GetReference(), []).append(fp)
    outline = pcbnew.SHAPE_POLY_SET()
    base.GetBoardPolygonOutlines(outline)
    for fp in base.GetFootprints():
        ref = fp.GetReference()
        if ref not in free:
            continue
        found = theirs.get(ref, [])
        if len(found) != 1:
            problems.append(f"part {ref} is {'not in' if not found else 'more than once in'} the file; left where it was parked")
        else:
            if found[0].GetLayer() != fp.GetLayer():
                fp.Flip(fp.GetPosition(), pcbnew.FLIP_DIRECTION_LEFT_RIGHT)
            fp.SetOrientation(found[0].GetOrientation())
            fp.SetPosition(found[0].GetPosition())
        nets = sorted({p.GetNetname() for p in fp.Pads() if p.GetNetname()})
        parts[fp.m_Uuid.AsString()] = nets
        for pad in fp.Pads():
            parts[pad.m_Uuid.AsString()] = [pad.GetNetname()] if pad.GetNetname() else nets
        if outline.OutlineCount() and not all(outline.Contains(pad.GetPosition()) for pad in fp.Pads()):
            off_board[ref] = nets
copper = {base.GetLayerName(layer) for layer in base.GetEnabledLayers().CuStack()}
items = list(routed.GetTracks())
if len(items) > int(max_items):
    json.dump({"error": f"too many tracks and vias ({len(items)}; the limit is {max_items})"}, open(owners_path, "w"))
    sys.exit(0)
for item in items:
    name = item.GetNetname()
    net = base.FindNet(name) if name else None
    if net is None:
        problems.append(f"an item is on net {name!r}, which the board does not have; skipped")
        continue
    if name in leave_off:
        continue
    kind = item.GetClass()
    if kind == "PCB_VIA":
        if item.GetViaType() != pcbnew.VIATYPE_THROUGH:
            problems.append("a via is blind, buried or micro; only vias through the whole board are read; skipped")
            continue
        new = pcbnew.PCB_VIA(base)
        new.SetPosition(item.GetPosition())
        new.SetViaType(pcbnew.VIATYPE_THROUGH)
        new.SetLayerPair(item.TopLayer(), item.BottomLayer())
        new.SetDrill(item.GetDrillValue())
        new.SetWidth(pcbnew.F_Cu, item.GetWidth(pcbnew.F_Cu))
    elif kind in ("PCB_TRACK", "PCB_ARC"):
        layer_name = routed.GetLayerName(item.GetLayer())
        if layer_name not in copper:
            problems.append(f"a track is on layer {layer_name!r}, which is not a copper layer of this board; skipped")
            continue
        new = pcbnew.PCB_ARC(base) if kind == "PCB_ARC" else pcbnew.PCB_TRACK(base)
        new.SetStart(item.GetStart())
        new.SetEnd(item.GetEnd())
        if kind == "PCB_ARC":
            new.SetMid(item.GetMid())
        new.SetWidth(item.GetWidth())
        new.SetLayer(base.GetLayerID(layer_name))
    else:
        continue
    new.SetNet(net)
    base.Add(new)
    owners[new.m_Uuid.AsString()] = name
pcbnew.ZONE_FILLER(base).Fill(base.Zones())
pcbnew.SaveBoard(out_path, base)
base.BuildConnectivity()
missing = base.GetConnectivity().GetUnconnectedCount(False)  # connections still missing, counted by KiCad itself
plain = {}  # net name as KiCad's reports print it -> net name as the board file spells it
for code in range(base.GetNetCount()):
    net = base.FindNet(code)
    if net is not None and net.GetNetname():
        plain[unescape(net.GetNetname())] = net.GetNetname()
json.dump({"owners": owners, "problems": problems, "missing": missing, "plain": plain, "parts": parts, "off_board": off_board},
          open(owners_path, "w"))
"""


def merge(routed_path, base_pcb, out_path, leave_off=(), free=()):
    """Copy tracks, arcs and vias from routed_path onto the pristine board, except those of the nets in
    leave_off; in a place-and-route task, also put each part named in free where routed_path has it;
    refill zones; save. Returns a dict: "owners" {uuid: net name} for the copied items, "problems",
    "missing" (how many connections KiCad still counts as missing), "plain" (net names as reports
    print them -> as the board spells them), "parts" {uuid of a free part or one of its pads: its nets}
    and "off_board" {reference of a free part that is not wholly on the board: its nets}. Runs KiCad's
    Python module in a child process: it prints debug lines and can crash when it exits, after its work
    is done."""
    owners_path = out_path + ".owners.json"
    leave_off_path = out_path + ".options.json"
    with open(leave_off_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump({"leave_off": sorted(leave_off), "free": sorted(free)}, f)
    for attempt in range(3):  # KiCad's Python module now and then dies before it has finished; try again
        done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", MERGE, routed_path, base_pcb, out_path, owners_path, str(MAX_ITEMS), leave_off_path],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1800)
        if os.path.exists(owners_path):
            break
    if not os.path.exists(owners_path):
        tail = (done.stderr or "").strip().splitlines()[-1:] or ["KiCad could not load or process the file"]
        raise ValueError(tail[0][:200])
    with open(owners_path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    os.unlink(owners_path)
    if "error" in data:
        raise ValueError(data["error"])
    return data


def drc(pcb_path):
    out = pcb_path + ".drc.json"
    for attempt in range(3):  # the same for kicad-cli: try again if it left no readable report
        subprocess.run(["kicad-cli", "pcb", "drc", "--format", "json", "--severity-all", "--all-track-errors", "--output", out, pcb_path],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1800)
        try:
            with open(out) as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
    raise ValueError("KiCad's design-rule check did not produce a report")


UNCONNECTED_LIMIT = 499                      # KiCad lists at most this many missing connections in one report
VIOLATION_LIMITS = {"clearance": 499}        # ... and at most this many violations of one kind
OTHER_VIOLATION_LIMIT = 199
MAX_ROUNDS = 12


def open_nets_of(report, plain):
    """Nets with an unconnected item in a DRC report, spelled as the board file spells them. KiCad
    describes an item as e.g. 'Pad 3 [/SDA] of U2 on F.Cu' or 'Track [GND] on B.Cu, length ...'."""
    nets = set()
    for entry in report.get("unconnected_items", []):
        for item in entry.get("items", []):
            d = item.get("description", "")
            if "[" in d and "]" in d:
                shown = d[d.index("[") + 1:d.rindex("]")]
                nets.add(plain.get(shown, shown))
    return nets


PROBE = r"""
import json, sys, pcbnew
board = pcbnew.LoadBoard(sys.argv[1])
nets = json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
pads = [p for fp in board.GetFootprints() for p in fp.Pads()]
zones = list(board.Zones())
tracks = list(board.GetTracks())
codes = {kind: [i.GetNetCode() for i in items] for kind, items in (("pads", pads), ("zones", zones), ("tracks", tracks))}
far = pcbnew.FromMM(1500)
parked = [False] * len(tracks)
def missing(group):
    # Connections KiCad counts as missing among these nets alone. Everything else is taken out of the
    # picture: pads and zones lose their net, tracks and vias lose their net and are parked far off the
    # board (KiCad gives a track that touches a pad the pad's net, so they must not touch anything).
    keep = {board.FindNet(n).GetNetCode() for n in group if board.FindNet(n) is not None}
    for item, code in zip(pads, codes["pads"]):
        item.SetNetCode(code if code in keep else 0)
    for item, code in zip(zones, codes["zones"]):
        item.SetNetCode(code if code in keep else 0)
    for k, (item, code) in enumerate(zip(tracks, codes["tracks"])):
        if (code in keep) == parked[k]:
            item.Move(pcbnew.VECTOR2I(-far if parked[k] else far, 0))
            parked[k] = not parked[k]
        item.SetNetCode(code if code in keep else 0)
    board.BuildConnectivity()
    return board.GetConnectivity().GetUnconnectedCount(False)
def open_among(group):  # split in halves until the open nets are singled out
    if not group or missing(group) == 0:
        return []
    if len(group) == 1:
        return list(group)
    half = len(group) // 2
    return open_among(group[:half]) + open_among(group[half:])
json.dump(open_among(nets), open(sys.argv[3], "w"))
"""


def probe_open(board_path, nets):
    """Which of these nets still have a missing connection on the board, by KiCad's connectivity engine."""
    if not nets:
        return set()
    ask, answer = board_path + ".probe.json", board_path + ".probed.json"
    with open(ask, "w") as f:
        json.dump(sorted(nets), f)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", PROBE, board_path, ask, answer], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1800)
    if not os.path.exists(answer):
        return set(nets)  # the probe did not finish: count none of them
    with open(answer) as f:
        return set(json.load(f))


DEAD_ENDS = {"track_dangling", "via_dangling"}  # KiCad only warns about these


def read_violations(report, owners, matched=()):
    """The violations that count and that involve copper from the routed file, and the nets of that copper.
    On a net whose length is matched against another (the nets in matched), a track or via that leads
    nowhere counts too: otherwise a dead-end stub would make up the length without carrying the signal."""
    violations, bad_nets = [], set()
    for v in report.get("violations", []):
        nets = {owners[i["uuid"]] for i in v.get("items", []) if i.get("uuid") in owners}
        if v.get("type") in DEAD_ENDS and v.get("severity") != "error":
            nets &= set(matched)
        elif v.get("severity") != "error" or v.get("type") not in COUNTED:
            continue
        if not nets:
            continue  # not about copper from the routed file
        bad_nets |= nets
        violations.append({"type": v["type"], "description": v.get("description", ""), "nets": sorted(nets),
                           "at": [(round(i["pos"]["x"], 3), round(i["pos"]["y"], 3)) for i in v.get("items", []) if "pos" in i][:2]})
    return violations, bad_nets


# In a place-and-route task, violations between the parts themselves count too.
PLACEMENT = {
    "clearance", "shorting_items", "hole_clearance", "hole_to_hole", "copper_edge_clearance", "courtyards_overlap",
    "items_not_allowed", "pth_inside_courtyard", "npth_inside_courtyard", "solder_mask_bridge",
}


def read_placement(report, owners, parts):
    """Violations that are about where a free part sits and involve no copper from the routed file
    (those are already counted against the copper), and the nets of the parts involved."""
    violations, bad_nets = [], set()
    for v in report.get("violations", []):
        if v.get("severity") != "error" or v.get("type") not in PLACEMENT:
            continue
        ids = [i.get("uuid") for i in v.get("items", [])]
        if any(i in owners for i in ids) or not any(i in parts for i in ids):
            continue
        nets = {n for i in ids for n in parts.get(i, [])}
        bad_nets |= nets
        violations.append({"type": v["type"], "description": v.get("description", ""), "nets": sorted(nets),
                           "at": [(round(i["pos"]["x"], 3), round(i["pos"]["y"], 3)) for i in v.get("items", []) if "pos" in i][:2]})
    return violations, bad_nets


def cut_short(report, kinds=COUNTED):
    """Kinds of violation, among those given, whose list KiCad stopped before the end."""
    seen = {}
    for v in report.get("violations", []):
        seen[v.get("type")] = seen.get(v.get("type"), 0) + 1
    return sorted(t for t, n in seen.items() if t in kinds and n >= VIOLATION_LIMITS.get(t, OTHER_VIOLATION_LIMIT))


def check(routed_path, keep=None, base_dir=None):
    base_dir = base_dir or BASE_DIR
    with open(os.path.join(base_dir, "task.json")) as f:
        task = json.load(f)
    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="boardcheck-")
    name = task["board"]
    routable = set(task["routable_nets"])
    free = task.get("free_footprints", [])  # a place-and-route task names the parts the agent has to place
    taken_off, violations, rounds, unfinished = set(), [], 0, []
    try:
        while True:
            rounds += 1
            merged = os.path.join(work, f"merged{rounds}", name + ".kicad_pcb")
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(merged))
            merged_info = merge(routed_path, os.path.join(base_dir, name + ".kicad_pcb"), merged, taken_off, free)
            owners = merged_info["owners"]
            if rounds == 1:
                items_read = len(owners)
            # KiCad's Python module writes a project file next to a board it saves, and on a fresh machine
            # that file holds KiCad's default rules, not the board's. So the check runs in a clean folder:
            # the merged board next to the pristine project file and the pristine rules file.
            rundir = os.path.join(work, f"drc{rounds}")
            os.makedirs(rundir)
            graded = os.path.join(rundir, name + ".kicad_pcb")
            shutil.copy(merged, graded)
            for ext in (".kicad_pro", ".kicad_dru"):
                src = os.path.join(base_dir, name + ext)
                if os.path.exists(src):
                    shutil.copy(src, os.path.join(rundir, name + ext))
            report = drc(graded)
            found, bad_nets = read_violations(report, owners, task.get("no_dead_end_nets", []))
            violations += found
            unfinished = cut_short(report)
            if not unfinished or not bad_nets or rounds >= MAX_ROUNDS:
                break
            taken_off |= bad_nets  # the list stopped early: take these nets off the board and look again
        open_nets = open_nets_of(report, merged_info["plain"])
        if len(report.get("unconnected_items", [])) >= UNCONNECTED_LIMIT:
            # The list of missing connections stopped early. A net with no new copper is certainly still
            # open. Every other net that is not on the list is tested on its own.
            with_copper = set(owners.values())
            open_nets |= routable - with_copper
            open_nets |= probe_open(graded, (with_copper | set(merged_info["plain"].values())) - open_nets)
        if keep:
            shutil.copy(graded, keep)
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
    problems = merged_info["problems"]
    still_cut_short = bool(unfinished and bad_nets)  # after MAX_ROUNDS
    placement = []
    if free:
        placement, misplaced = read_placement(report, owners, merged_info["parts"])
        for ref, nets in sorted(merged_info["off_board"].items()):
            placement.append({"type": "part_off_board", "description": f"Part {ref} is not wholly on the board", "nets": nets, "at": []})
            misplaced |= set(nets)
        if cut_short(report, PLACEMENT):  # the list of placement problems stopped early: count no placed part
            misplaced |= {n for nets in merged_info["parts"].values() for n in nets}
            problems = problems + ["KiCad's list of violations between parts was cut short; no net of a placed part is counted"]
        bad_nets = bad_nets | misplaced
        violations += placement
    if still_cut_short:  # nothing left on the board is counted
        bad_nets = bad_nets | set(owners.values())
        problems = problems + [f"KiCad's list of violations was still cut short after {MAX_ROUNDS} rounds; no net with copper on the board is counted"]
    bad_nets = bad_nets | taken_off
    failed = open_nets | bad_nets
    good = routable - failed
    collateral = failed - routable  # nets that needed no routing and are now broken, e.g. a cut ground pour
    reward = max(0.0, (len(good) - len(collateral)) / len(routable)) if routable else 0.0
    return {
        "reward": round(reward, 4),
        "full_pass": int(not failed and not violations),
        "nets_to_route": len(routable),
        "nets_good": len(good),
        "nets_open": len(open_nets & routable),
        "nets_with_violations": len(bad_nets),
        "other_nets_broken": len(collateral),
        "violations": len(violations),
        "tracks_and_vias": items_read,
        "connections_missing": merged_info["missing"],
        "rounds": rounds,
        "parts_to_place": len(free),
        "placement_violations": len(placement),
        "detail": {"good_nets": sorted(good), "open_nets": sorted(open_nets), "violations": violations[:200], "problems": problems[:50]},
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument("routed")
    parser.add_argument("--board", help="which board the file is a routing of, where there are several: a folder name under "
                                        + os.path.join(HERE, "boards"))
    parser.add_argument("--json")
    parser.add_argument("--keep", help="save the board that was actually checked (pristine board + your copper, zones refilled)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    base_dir = os.path.join(HERE, "boards", args.board) if args.board else BASE_DIR
    if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(base_dir, "task.json")):
        boards = sorted(os.listdir(os.path.join(HERE, "boards"))) if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(HERE, "boards")) else []
        print("boardcheck needs to know which board this is: --board <name>" + (", one of " + ", ".join(boards) if boards else ""))
        return 2
    try:
        result = check(args.routed, args.keep, base_dir)
    except Exception as exc:  # a file KiCad cannot load, and the like
        result = {"reward": 0.0, "full_pass": 0, "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"}
    if args.json:
        with open(args.json, "w") as f:
            json.dump(result, f, indent=1)
    if "error" in result:
        print("boardcheck could not check this file:", result["error"])
        return 1
    print(f"Nets to route: {result['nets_to_route']}")
    print(f"  fully connected and free of violations: {result['nets_good']}")
    print(f"  still open: {result['nets_open']}")
    print(f"  with design-rule violations: {result['nets_with_violations']} ({result['violations']} violations)")

        print(f"  {v['type']}: {v['description']} nets {v['nets']} near {v['at']}")

        print(f"  ... and {len(detail['violations']) - 40} more (use --json for all)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Grid maze router for 2-layer KiCad boards.

Usage: python3 route.py <board.kicad_pcb> <routed.kicad_pcb>
"""
import os
import sys
import re
import json
import math
import time
import heapq

import numpy as np
import pcbnew

T0 = time.time()
BUDGET = float(os.environ.get("ROUTER_BUDGET", "420"))


def elapsed():
    return time.time() - T0


def log(*a):
    if os.environ.get("ROUTER_VERBOSE"):
        print("[%6.1fs]" % elapsed(), *a, file=sys.stderr, flush=True)


MM = 1000000.0  # nm per mm


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- rules ----

def load_project(path):
    pro = os.path.splitext(path)[0] + ".kicad_pro"
    try:
        with open(pro) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception:
        return {}


def parse_dru(path):
    """-> (min width per net in nm, max skew per diff-pair prefix in nm)."""
    dru = os.path.splitext(path)[0] + ".kicad_dru"
    widths, skews = {}, {}
    try:
        with open(dru) as f:
            text = f.read()
    except Exception:
        return widths, skews
    # split into rules
    for m in re.finditer(r'\(rule\s', text):
        start = m.start()
        depth, i = 0, start
        while i < len(text):
            if text[i] == '(':
                depth += 1
            elif text[i] == ')':
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0:
                    break
            i += 1
        body = text[start:i + 1]
        cond = re.search(r'\(condition\s+"(.*?)"\s*\)', body, re.S)
        if not cond:
            continue
        c = cond.group(1)
        wm = re.search(r'\(constraint\s+track_width\s*\(min\s+([0-9.]+)mm\s*\)', body)
        if wm:
            w = int(round(float(wm.group(1)) * MM))
            for nm in re.findall(r"A\.NetName\s*==\s*'([^']*)'", c):
                widths[nm] = max(widths.get(nm, 0), w)
        sm = re.search(r'\(constraint\s+skew\s*\(max\s+([0-9.]+)mm\s*\)', body)
        if sm:
            s = int(round(float(sm.group(1)) * MM))
            for nm in re.findall(r"A\.inDiffPair\('([^']*)'\)", c):
                skews[nm] = s
    return widths, skews


def netclass_of(name, pro):
    ns = pro.get("net_settings", {}) or {}
    classes = {c.get("name"): c for c in ns.get("classes", []) or []}
    assign = ns.get("netclass_assignments") or {}
    cn = assign.get(name)
    if isinstance(cn, list):
        cn = cn[0] if cn else None
    if cn and cn in classes:
        return classes[cn]
    import fnmatch
    for pat in ns.get("netclass_patterns") or []:
        p = pat.get("pattern", "")
        try:
            if fnmatch.fnmatchcase(name, p) or re.fullmatch(p, name):
                c = classes.get(pat.get("netclass"))
                if c:
                    return c
        except Exception:
            pass
    return classes.get("Default", {})


# --------------------------------------------------------------- raster ----

def dilate_disk(mask, r):
    """Binary dilation by a Euclidean disk of radius r cells."""
    if r <= 0:
        return mask
    h, w = mask.shape
    # horizontal dilations by 0..r
    hd = [mask]
    cur = mask
    for j in range(1, r + 1):
        nxt = cur.copy()
        nxt[:, 1:] |= cur[:, :-1]
        nxt[:, :-1] |= cur[:, 1:]
        hd.append(nxt)
        cur = nxt
    out = np.zeros_like(mask)
    r2 = r * r
    for dy in range(-r, r + 1):
        dx = int(math.isqrt(max(0, r2 - dy * dy)))
        src = hd[dx]
        if dy == 0:
            out |= src
        elif dy > 0:
            out[dy:, :] |= src[:-dy, :]
        else:
            out[:dy, :] |= src[-dy:, :]
    return out


class Grid:
    def __init__(self, x0, y0, w, h, pitch):
        self.x0, self.y0, self.pitch = x0, y0, pitch
        self.W, self.H = w, h

    def to_cell(self, x, y):
        return (int((x - self.x0) // self.pitch), int((y - self.y0) // self.pitch))

    def to_nm(self, ix, iy):
        return (int(self.x0 + (ix + 0.5) * self.pitch), int(self.y0 + (iy + 0.5) * self.pitch))


def poly_mask(grid, pts, pad_cells=0):
    """Rasterize polygon (list of (x,y) nm). Returns (x0,y0,mask) window indices."""
    xs = [p[0] for p in pts]
    ys = [p[1] for p in pts]
    ix0 = max(0, int((min(xs) - grid.x0) // grid.pitch) - 1 - pad_cells)
    ix1 = min(grid.W - 1, int((max(xs) - grid.x0) // grid.pitch) + 1 + pad_cells)
    iy0 = max(0, int((min(ys) - grid.y0) // grid.pitch) - 1 - pad_cells)
    iy1 = min(grid.H - 1, int((max(ys) - grid.y0) // grid.pitch) + 1 + pad_cells)
    if ix1 < ix0 or iy1 < iy0:
        return None
    X = grid.x0 + (np.arange(ix0, ix1 + 1) + 0.5) * grid.pitch
    Y = grid.y0 + (np.arange(iy0, iy1 + 1) + 0.5) * grid.pitch
    XX = X[None, :]
    YY = Y[:, None]
    inside = np.zeros((len(Y), len(X)), dtype=bool)
    n = len(pts)
    for i in range(n):
        x1, y1 = pts[i]
        x2, y2 = pts[(i + 1) % n]
        if y1 == y2:
            continue
        cond = ((y1 > YY) != (y2 > YY))
        with np.errstate(invalid='ignore', divide='ignore'):
            xint = (x2 - x1) * (YY - y1) / (y2 - y1) + x1
        inside ^= (cond & (XX < xint))
    return ix0, iy0, inside


def disk_mask(grid, cx, cy, r, pad_cells=0):
    ix0 = max(0, int((cx - r - grid.x0) // grid.pitch) - 1 - pad_cells)
    ix1 = min(grid.W - 1, int((cx + r - grid.x0) // grid.pitch) + 1 + pad_cells)
    iy0 = max(0, int((cy - r - grid.y0) // grid.pitch) - 1 - pad_cells)
    iy1 = min(grid.H - 1, int((cy + r - grid.y0) // grid.pitch) + 1 + pad_cells)
    if ix1 < ix0 or iy1 < iy0:
        return None
    X = grid.x0 + (np.arange(ix0, ix1 + 1) + 0.5) * grid.pitch - cx
    Y = grid.y0 + (np.arange(iy0, iy1 + 1) + 0.5) * grid.pitch - cy
    m = (X[None, :] ** 2 + Y[:, None] ** 2) <= float(r) ** 2
    return ix0, iy0, m


def seg_mask(grid, p, q, r, pad_cells=0):
    (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = p, q
    ix0 = max(0, int((min(x1, x2) - r - grid.x0) // grid.pitch) - 1 - pad_cells)
    ix1 = min(grid.W - 1, int((max(x1, x2) + r - grid.x0) // grid.pitch) + 1 + pad_cells)
    iy0 = max(0, int((min(y1, y2) - r - grid.y0) // grid.pitch) - 1 - pad_cells)
    iy1 = min(grid.H - 1, int((max(y1, y2) + r - grid.y0) // grid.pitch) + 1 + pad_cells)
    if ix1 < ix0 or iy1 < iy0:
        return None
    X = grid.x0 + (np.arange(ix0, ix1 + 1) + 0.5) * grid.pitch
    Y = grid.y0 + (np.arange(iy0, iy1 + 1) + 0.5) * grid.pitch
    px = X[None, :] - x1
    py = Y[:, None] - y1
    vx, vy = float(x2 - x1), float(y2 - y1)
    L2 = vx * vx + vy * vy
    if L2 <= 0:
        d2 = px ** 2 + py ** 2
    else:
        t = np.clip((px * vx + py * vy) / L2, 0.0, 1.0)
        d2 = (px - t * vx) ** 2 + (py - t * vy) ** 2
    return ix0, iy0, d2 <= float(r) ** 2


# --------------------------------------------------------------- router ----

FAKE_NET = 30000


class Router:
    def __init__(self, board, path):
        self.board = board
        self.pro = load_project(path)
        self.dru_w, self.dru_skew = parse_dru(path)
        rules = (self.pro.get("board", {}).get("design_settings", {}) or {}).get("rules", {}) or {}
        self.min_clearance = int(round(rules.get("min_clearance", 0.0) * MM))
        self.min_track = int(round(rules.get("min_track_width", 0.2) * MM))
        self.min_via_dia = int(round(rules.get("min_via_diameter", 0.4) * MM))
        self.min_via_ann = int(round(rules.get("min_via_annular_width", 0.05) * MM))
        self.min_drill = int(round(rules.get("min_through_hole_diameter", 0.3) * MM))
        self.edge_cl = int(round(rules.get("min_copper_edge_clearance", 0.0) * MM))
        self.hole_cl = int(round(rules.get("min_hole_clearance", 0.0) * MM))
        self.h2h = int(round(rules.get("min_hole_to_hole", 0.25) * MM))
        ns = self.pro.get("net_settings", {}) or {}
        cls = ns.get("classes", []) or [{}]
        self.clearance = max([int(round((c.get("clearance", 0.2) or 0.2) * MM)) for c in cls] + [self.min_clearance])
        self.layers = list(board.GetEnabledLayers().CuStack())
        if len(self.layers) > 2:
            self.layers = [pcbnew.F_Cu, pcbnew.B_Cu]
        self.nlay = len(self.layers)
        self.lay_index = {l: i for i, l in enumerate(self.layers)}

        # via geometry: smallest legal
        drill = max(self.min_drill, int(0.3 * MM))
        dia = max(self.min_via_dia, drill + 2 * self.min_via_ann + 20000)
        self.via_drill = drill + 2000
        self.via_dia = dia + 2000

    # ---- net info
    def setup_nets(self):
        b = self.board
        self.nets = {}        # name -> id
        self.net_names = {}   # id -> name
        self.net_width = {}
        nid = 0
        pads_by_net = {}
        for fp in b.GetFootprints():
            for pad in fp.Pads():
                name = pad.GetNetname()
                if not name:
                    continue
                pads_by_net.setdefault(name, []).append(pad)
        for name in sorted(pads_by_net):
            if len(pads_by_net[name]) < 1:
                continue
            nid += 1
            self.nets[name] = nid
            self.net_names[nid] = name
            w = max(self.min_track, self.dru_w.get(name, 0))
            self.net_width[nid] = w + 1000
        self.pads_by_net = pads_by_net

    def setup_grid(self):
        b = self.board
        poly = pcbnew.SHAPE_POLY_SET()
        try:
            ok = b.GetBoardPolygonOutlines(poly)
        except Exception:
            ok = False
        bb = b.GetBoardEdgesBoundingBox()
        x0, y0 = bb.GetX(), bb.GetY()
        wnm, hnm = bb.GetWidth(), bb.GetHeight()
        if wnm <= 0 or hnm <= 0:
            bb = b.GetBoundingBox()
            x0, y0, wnm, hnm = bb.GetX(), bb.GetY(), bb.GetWidth(), bb.GetHeight()
        margin = int(0.6 * MM)
        x0 -= margin
        y0 -= margin
        wnm += 2 * margin
        hnm += 2 * margin
        area_mm2 = (wnm / MM) * (hnm / MM)
        pitch = max(0.05, math.sqrt(area_mm2 / 1.7e6))
        pitch = math.ceil(pitch * 200) / 200.0  # round to 0.005mm
        self.pitch_nm = pitch * MM
        W = int(wnm / self.pitch_nm) + 1
        H = int(hnm / self.pitch_nm) + 1
        self.grid = Grid(x0, y0, W, H, self.pitch_nm)
        self.W, self.H = W, H
        self.HW = W * H
        log("grid %dx%d pitch %.3fmm cells %d" % (W, H, pitch, W * H))
        # inside-outline mask
        inside = np.zeros((H, W), dtype=bool)
        if ok and poly.OutlineCount() > 0:
            for oi in range(poly.OutlineCount()):
                o = poly.Outline(oi)
                pts = [(o.CPoint(i).x, o.CPoint(i).y) for i in range(o.PointCount())]
                res = poly_mask(self.grid, pts)
                if res:
                    ax, ay, m = res
                    inside[ay:ay + m.shape[0], ax:ax + m.shape[1]] |= m
            for oi in range(poly.OutlineCount()):
                o = poly.Outline(oi)
                for hi in range(poly.HoleCount(oi)):
                    hpoly = poly.Hole(oi, hi)
                    pts = [(hpoly.CPoint(i).x, hpoly.CPoint(i).y) for i in range(hpoly.PointCount())]
                    res = poly_mask(self.grid, pts)
                    if res:
                        ax, ay, m = res
                        inside[ay:ay + m.shape[0], ax:ax + m.shape[1]] &= ~m
        if inside.sum() < 0.05 * H * W:
            inside[:, :] = True
            inside[0, :] = False
            inside[-1, :] = False
            inside[:, 0] = False
            inside[:, -1] = False
        self.inside = inside

    # ---- obstacle buckets
    def bucket_for(self, halfw):
        rc = int(math.ceil((self.clearance + halfw) / self.pitch_nm - 1e-9))
        re_ = int(math.ceil((self.edge_cl + halfw) / self.pitch_nm - 1e-9))
        key = (rc, re_)
        if key not in self.buckets:
            n1 = [np.zeros((self.H, self.W), dtype=np.int16) for _ in range(self.nlay)]
            n2 = [np.zeros((self.H, self.W), dtype=np.int16) for _ in range(self.nlay)]
            ov = [np.zeros((self.H, self.W), dtype=bool) for _ in range(self.nlay)]
            outside = ~np.ascontiguousarray(dilate_disk(~self.inside, re_) == False)
            self.buckets[key] = dict(rc=rc, n1=n1, n2=n2, ov=ov, outside=outside)
            self.bucket_order.append(key)
        return self.buckets[key]

    def add_obstacle(self, layer_ids, win, netid):
        """win = (ix0, iy0, mask) of actual copper."""
        if win is None:
            return
        ax, ay, m = win
        if not m.any():
            return
        h, w = m.shape
        for key in self.bucket_order:
            bk = self.buckets[key]
            r = bk['rc']
            # pad window by r
            px0 = max(0, ax - r)
            py0 = max(0, ay - r)
            px1 = min(self.W, ax + w + r)
            py1 = min(self.H, ay + h + r)
            big = np.zeros((py1 - py0, px1 - px0), dtype=bool)
            big[ay - py0:ay - py0 + h, ax - px0:ax - px0 + w] = m
            d = dilate_disk(big, r)
            for li in layer_ids:
                s1 = bk['n1'][li][py0:py1, px0:px1]
                s2 = bk['n2'][li][py0:py1, px0:px1]
                so = bk['ov'][li][py0:py1, px0:px1]
                a = d & (s1 == 0)
                s1[a] = netid
                nd = d & (s1 != netid)
                a2 = nd & (s2 == 0)
                s2[a2] = netid
                so |= nd & (s2 != netid)

    def rasterize_pads(self):
        b = self.board
        self.occ = [np.zeros((self.H, self.W), dtype=np.int16) for _ in range(self.nlay)]
        self.pad_cells = {}
        items = []
        for fp in b.GetFootprints():
            for pad in fp.Pads():
                name = pad.GetNetname()
                nid = self.nets.get(name, FAKE_NET)
                lset = set(pad.GetLayerSet().CuStack())
                lids = [self.lay_index[l] for l in self.layers if l in lset]
                drill = max(pad.GetDrillSizeX(), pad.GetDrillSizeY())
                if drill > 0:
                    lids = list(range(self.nlay))
                if not lids:
                    continue
                items.append((pad, nid, lids, drill))
        for pad, nid, lids, drill in items:
            wins = []
            try:
                lay = self.layers[lids[0]]
                ep = pad.GetEffectivePolygon(lay)
                for oi in range(ep.OutlineCount()):
                    o = ep.Outline(oi)
                    pts = [(o.CPoint(i).x, o.CPoint(i).y) for i in range(o.PointCount())]
                    if len(pts) >= 3:
                        wins.append(poly_mask(self.grid, pts))
            except Exception:
                bb = pad.GetBoundingBox()
                pts = [(bb.GetX(), bb.GetY()), (bb.GetRight(), bb.GetY()),
                       (bb.GetRight(), bb.GetBottom()), (bb.GetX(), bb.GetBottom())]
                wins.append(poly_mask(self.grid, pts))
            if drill > 0:
                extra = max(0, self.hole_cl - self.clearance)
                p = pad.GetPosition()
                wins.append(disk_mask(self.grid, p.x, p.y, drill / 2.0 + extra))
            for win in wins:
                if win is None:
                    continue
                ax, ay, m = win
                for li in lids:
                    sub = self.occ[li][ay:ay + m.shape[0], ax:ax + m.shape[1]]
                    sub[m & (sub == 0)] = nid
                self.add_obstacle(lids, win, nid)
            if nid != FAKE_NET:
                key = (nid, pad.GetPosition().x, pad.GetPosition().y)
                cells = set()
                for win in wins[:1]:
                    if win is None:
                        continue
                    ax, ay, m = win
                    ys, xs = np.nonzero(m)
                    for yy, xx in zip(ys, xs):
                        cells.add((int(ay + yy), int(ax + xx)))
                if not cells:
                    p = pad.GetPosition()
                    cx, cy = self.grid.to_cell(p.x, p.y)
                    cells.add((cy, cx))
                self.pad_cells.setdefault(nid, []).append((cells, lids, pad))
        # drilled holes with no net / board edge handled by outside mask

    # ---- passability
    def passable_for(self, nid, halfw):
        bk = self.bucket_for(halfw)
        out = []
        for li in range(self.nlay):
            blocked = bk['ov'][li] | bk['outside']
            n1 = bk['n1'][li]
            n2 = bk['n2'][li]
            blocked |= (n1 != 0) & (n1 != nid)
            blocked |= (n2 != 0) & (n2 != nid)
            p = ~blocked
            p |= (self.occ[li] == nid)
            out.append(p)
        return out

    # ---- A*
    def astar(self, passable, via_ok, srcs, tgts, tcell, max_pop=400000, via_cost=160):
        W, HW, nlay = self.W, self.HW, self.nlay
        tx, ty = tcell
        wgt = 13
        push = heapq.heappush
        pop = heapq.heappop
        closed = bytearray(nlay * HW)
        g = {}
        par = {}
        heap = []
        for s in srcs:
            if s in g:
                continue
            g[s] = 0
            li = s // HW
            rem = s - li * HW
            y, x = divmod(rem, W)
            dx = abs(x - tx)
            dy = abs(y - ty)
            h = (10 * (dx + dy) - 6 * min(dx, dy)) * wgt // 10
            push(heap, (h, 0, s))
        dirs = ((1, 10), (-1, 10), (W, 10), (-W, 10), (W + 1, 14), (W - 1, 14), (-W + 1, 14), (-W - 1, 14))
        pops = 0
        found = None
        while heap:
            f, gc, u = pop(heap)
            if closed[u]:
                continue
            closed[u] = 1
            pops += 1
            if u in tgts:
                found = u
                break
            if pops > max_pop:
                break
            li = u // HW
            base = li * HW
            rem = u - base
            y, x = divmod(rem, W)
            for d, c in dirs:
                v = u + d
                if closed[v] or not passable[v]:
                    continue
                ng = gc + c
                old = g.get(v)
                if old is not None and old <= ng:
                    continue
                g[v] = ng
                par[v] = u
                vy, vx = divmod(v - base, W)
                dx = abs(vx - tx)
                dy = abs(vy - ty)
                h = (10 * (dx + dy) - 6 * (dx if dx < dy else dy)) * wgt // 10
                push(heap, (ng + h, ng, v))
            if nlay > 1 and via_ok[rem]:
                v = rem if li else rem + HW
                if not closed[v] and passable[v]:
                    ng = gc + via_cost
                    old = g.get(v)
                    if old is None or old > ng:
                        g[v] = ng
                        par[v] = u
                        dx = abs(x - tx)
                        dy = abs(y - ty)
                        h = (10 * (dx + dy) - 6 * (dx if dx < dy else dy)) * wgt // 10
                        push(heap, (ng + h, ng, v))
        if found is None:
            return None
        path = [found]
        while found in par:
            found = par[found]
            path.append(found)
        path.reverse()
        return path

    # ---- main routing
    def route(self):
        self.buckets = {}
        self.bucket_order = []
        self.setup_nets()
        self.setup_grid()
        # create buckets for all widths up front (so incremental updates cover them)
        halfws = set()
        for nid, w in self.net_width.items():
            halfws.add(w // 2)
        halfws.add(self.via_dia // 2)
        for hw in sorted(halfws):
            self.bucket_for(hw)
        log("buckets", self.bucket_order)
        self.rasterize_pads()
        log("pads rasterized")
        self.tracks = []  # (layer_index, (x1,y1), (x2,y2), width, netid)
        self.vias = []    # (x, y, netid)
        self.net_len = {}

        order = self.net_order()
        for nid in order:
            if elapsed() > BUDGET:
                log("out of time, stopping")
                break
            self.route_net(nid)
        return self.tracks, self.vias

    def net_order(self):
        groups = []
        for nid, plist in self.pad_cells.items():
            if len(plist) < 2:
                continue
            pts = [p[2].GetPosition() for p in plist]
            xs = [p.x for p in pts]
            ys = [p.y for p in pts]
            span = (max(xs) - min(xs)) + (max(ys) - min(ys))
            groups.append((len(plist), span, nid))
        groups.sort()
        # diff pairs first
        pair_nets = set()
        for prefix in self.dru_skew:
            for name, nid in self.nets.items():
                if name.startswith(prefix) and len(name) == len(prefix) + 1:
                    pair_nets.add(nid)
        first = [g[2] for g in groups if g[2] in pair_nets]
        rest = [g[2] for g in groups if g[2] not in pair_nets]
        return first + rest

    def route_net(self, nid):
        name = self.net_names[nid]
        w = self.net_width[nid]
        halfw = w // 2
        plist = self.pad_cells[nid]
        if len(plist) < 2:
            return
        t_start = elapsed()
        pas = self.passable_for(nid, halfw)
        pasv = self.passable_for(nid, self.via_dia // 2)
        via_ok = pasv[0]
        for li in range(1, self.nlay):
            via_ok = via_ok & pasv[li]
        via_ok_b = via_ok.tobytes()
        passable_b = bytearray()
        for li in range(self.nlay):
            passable_b += pas[li].tobytes()
        passable_b = bytes(passable_b)

        # components: start from pad 0
        comps = []
        for cells, lids, pad in plist:
            idxs = set()
            for (yy, xx) in cells:
                for li in lids:
                    idxs.add(li * self.HW + yy * self.W + xx)
            p = pad.GetPosition()
            cx, cy = self.grid.to_cell(p.x, p.y)
            for li in lids:
                idxs.add(li * self.HW + cy * self.W + cx)
            comps.append({'idx': idxs, 'pos': (p.x, p.y), 'cell': (cx, cy)})

        connected = comps[0]
        remaining = comps[1:]
        placed_any = False
        while remaining:
            if elapsed() > BUDGET:
                break
            # nearest remaining component to connected set (by pad position)
            bestk, bestd = 0, None
            for k, c in enumerate(remaining):
                d = min((abs(c['pos'][0] - q[0]) + abs(c['pos'][1] - q[1]))
                        for q in [connected['pos']]) if False else None
                d = min(abs(c['cell'][0] - cc) + abs(c['cell'][1] - rr)
                        for (cc, rr) in [(connected['cell'][0], connected['cell'][1])])
                if bestd is None or d < bestd:
                    bestd, bestk = d, k
            tgt = remaining.pop(bestk)
            srcs = [u for u in connected['idx'] if passable_b[u]]
            if not srcs:
                srcs = list(connected['idx'])
            tg = set(u for u in tgt['idx'] if passable_b[u])
            if not tg:
                tg = set(tgt['idx'])
            path = self.astar(passable_b, via_ok_b, srcs, tg, tgt['cell'],
                              max_pop=self.pop_limit(), via_cost=self.via_cost(w))
            if path is None:
                log("  fail %s" % name)
                connected['idx'] |= tgt['idx']
                connected['cell'] = tgt['cell']
                continue
            placed_any = True
            new_cells = self.emit_path(path, nid, w)
            connected['idx'] |= tgt['idx']
            connected['idx'] |= new_cells
            connected['cell'] = tgt['cell']
            # refresh passability: own new copper now passable
            for u in new_cells:
                pass
            passable_b = self.refresh(nid, halfw, pas)
        if placed_any:
            log("  net %s (%d pads) %.1fs" % (name, len(plist), elapsed() - t_start))

    def refresh(self, nid, halfw, pas):
        for li in range(self.nlay):
            pas[li] |= (self.occ[li] == nid)
        b = bytearray()
        for li in range(self.nlay):
            b += pas[li].tobytes()
        return bytes(b)

    def pop_limit(self):
        left = BUDGET - elapsed()
        if left < 30:
            return 20000
        return 300000

    def via_cost(self, w):
        return max(80, int(12 * self.pitch_nm // self.pitch_nm) * 10 + 120)

    def emit_path(self, path, nid, w):
        """Turn a node path into tracks + vias; update occupancy."""
        HW, W = self.HW, self.W
        pts = []
        for u in path:
            li = u // HW
            rem = u - li * HW
            y, x = divmod(rem, W)
            pts.append((li, x, y))
        # compress collinear runs
        segs = []
        vias = []
        i = 0
        while i < len(pts) - 1:
            li, x, y = pts[i]
            lj, x2, y2 = pts[i + 1]
            if lj != li:
                vias.append((x, y))
                i += 1
                continue
            dx = x2 - x
            dy = y2 - y
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(pts) - 1:
                lk, x3, y3 = pts[j + 1]
                if lk != li or (x3 - pts[j][1]) != dx or (y3 - pts[j][2]) != dy:
                    break
                j += 1
            a = pts[i]
            b2 = pts[j]
            segs.append((li, (a[1], a[2]), (b2[1], b2[2])))
            i = j
        new_cells = set()
        halfr = w / 2.0
        for li, (x1, y1), (x2, y2) in segs:
            p = self.grid.to_nm(x1, y1)
            q = self.grid.to_nm(x2, y2)
            self.tracks.append((li, p, q, w, nid))
            win = seg_mask(self.grid, p, q, halfr)
            if win:
                ax, ay, m = win
                sub = self.occ[li][ay:ay + m.shape[0], ax:ax + m.shape[1]]
                sub[m & (sub == 0)] = nid
                self.add_obstacle([li], win, nid)
                ys, xs = np.nonzero(m)
                base = li * self.HW
                new_cells.update((base + (ay + int(yy)) * self.W + (ax + int(xx))) for yy, xx in zip(ys, xs))
        for (x, y) in vias:
            p = self.grid.to_nm(x, y)
            self.vias.append((p[0], p[1], nid))
            win = disk_mask(self.grid, p[0], p[1], self.via_dia / 2.0)
            if win:
                ax, ay, m = win
                for li in range(self.nlay):
                    sub = self.occ[li][ay:ay + m.shape[0], ax:ax + m.shape[1]]
                    sub[m & (sub == 0)] = nid
                self.add_obstacle(list(range(self.nlay)), win, nid)
                ys, xs = np.nonzero(m)
                for li in range(self.nlay):
                    base = li * self.HW
                    new_cells.update((base + (ay + int(yy)) * self.W + (ax + int(xx))) for yy, xx in zip(ys, xs))
        return new_cells

    # ---- output
    def write(self, out_path):
        b = self.board
        for li, p, q, w, nid in self.tracks:
            t = pcbnew.PCB_TRACK(b)
            t.SetStart(pcbnew.VECTOR2I(int(p[0]), int(p[1])))
            t.SetEnd(pcbnew.VECTOR2I(int(q[0]), int(q[1])))
            t.SetWidth(int(w))
            t.SetLayer(self.layers[li])
            net = b.FindNet(self.net_names[nid])
            if net:
                t.SetNet(net)
            b.Add(t)
        for (x, y, nid) in self.vias:
            v = pcbnew.PCB_VIA(b)
            v.SetPosition(pcbnew.VECTOR2I(int(x), int(y)))
            v.SetViaType(pcbnew.VIATYPE_THROUGH)
            v.SetLayerPair(self.layers[0], self.layers[-1])
            v.SetDrill(int(self.via_drill))
            try:
                v.SetWidth(self.layers[0], int(self.via_dia))
            except TypeError:
                v.SetWidth(int(self.via_dia))
            net = b.FindNet(self.net_names[nid])
            if net:
                v.SetNet(net)
            b.Add(v)
        pcbnew.SaveBoard(out_path, b)


def main():
    src, dst = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    board = pcbnew.LoadBoard(src)
    # safety: always leave a valid file behind
    try:
        pcbnew.SaveBoard(dst, board)
    except Exception:
        pass
    r = Router(board, src)
    try:
        r.route()
    except Exception as exc:
        log("router error: %r" % (exc,))
        import traceback
        if os.environ.get("ROUTER_VERBOSE"):
            traceback.print_exc()
    r.write(dst)
    log("done: %d tracks %d vias" % (len(r.tracks), len(r.vias)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Grid maze router for 2-layer KiCad boards.

Usage: python3 route.py <board.kicad_pcb> <routed.kicad_pcb>
"""
import os
import sys
import re
import json
import math
import time
import heapq

import numpy as np
import pcbnew

T0 = time.time()
BUDGET = float(os.environ.get("ROUTER_BUDGET", "420"))


def elapsed():
    return time.time() - T0


def log(*a):
    if os.environ.get("ROUTER_VERBOSE"):
        print("[%6.1fs]" % elapsed(), *a, file=sys.stderr, flush=True)


MM = 1000000.0  # nm per mm


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- rules ----

def load_project(path):
    pro = os.path.splitext(path)[0] + ".kicad_pro"
    try:
        with open(pro) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception:
        return {}


def parse_dru(path):
    """-> (min width per net in nm, max skew per diff-pair prefix in nm)."""
    dru = os.path.splitext(path)[0] + ".kicad_dru"
    widths, skews = {}, {}
    try:
        with open(dru) as f:
            text = f.read()
    except Exception:
        return widths, skews
    # split into rules
    for m in re.finditer(r'\(rule\s', text):
        start = m.start()
        depth, i = 0, start
        while i < len(text):
            if text[i] == '(':
                depth += 1
            elif text[i] == ')':
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0:
                    break
            i += 1
        body = text[start:i + 1]
        cond = re.search(r'\(condition\s+"(.*?)"\s*\)', body, re.S)
        if not cond:
            continue
        c = cond.group(1)
        wm = re.search(r'\(constraint\s+track_width\s*\(min\s+([0-9.]+)mm\s*\)', body)
        if wm:
            w = int(round(float(wm.group(1)) * MM))
            for nm in re.findall(r"A\.NetName\s*==\s*'([^']*)'", c):
                widths[nm] = max(widths.get(nm, 0), w)
        sm = re.search(r'\(constraint\s+skew\s*\(max\s+([0-9.]+)mm\s*\)', body)
        if sm:
            s = int(round(float(sm.group(1)) * MM))
            for nm in re.findall(r"A\.inDiffPair\('([^']*)'\)", c):
                skews[nm] = s
    return widths, skews


def netclass_of(name, pro):
    ns = pro.get("net_settings", {}) or {}
    classes = {c.get("name"): c for c in ns.get("classes", []) or []}
    assign = ns.get("netclass_assignments") or {}
    cn = assign.get(name)
    if isinstance(cn, list):
        cn = cn[0] if cn else None
    if cn and cn in classes:
        return classes[cn]
    import fnmatch
    for pat in ns.get("netclass_patterns") or []:
        p = pat.get("pattern", "")
        try:
            if fnmatch.fnmatchcase(name, p) or re.fullmatch(p, name):
                c = classes.get(pat.get("netclass"))
                if c:
                    return c
        except Exception:
            pass
    return classes.get("Default", {})


# --------------------------------------------------------------- raster ----

def dilate_disk(mask, r):
    """Binary dilation by a Euclidean disk of radius r cells."""
    if r <= 0:
        return mask
    h, w = mask.shape
    # horizontal dilations by 0..r
    hd = [mask]
    cur = mask
    for j in range(1, r + 1):
        nxt = cur.copy()
        nxt[:, 1:] |= cur[:, :-1]
        nxt[:, :-1] |= cur[:, 1:]
        hd.append(nxt)
        cur = nxt
    out = np.zeros_like(mask)
    r2 = r * r
    for dy in range(-r, r + 1):
        dx = int(math.isqrt(max(0, r2 - dy * dy)))
        src = hd[dx]
        if dy == 0:
            out |= src
        elif dy > 0:
            out[dy:, :] |= src[:-dy, :]
        else:
            out[:dy, :] |= src[-dy:, :]
    return out


class Grid:
    def __init__(self, x0, y0, w, h, pitch):
        self.x0, self.y0, self.pitch = x0, y0, pitch
        self.W, self.H = w, h

    def to_cell(self, x, y):
        return (int((x - self.x0) // self.pitch), int((y - self.y0) // self.pitch))

    def to_nm(self, ix, iy):
        return (int(self.x0 + (ix + 0.5) * self.pitch), int(self.y0 + (iy + 0.5) * self.pitch))


def poly_mask(grid, pts, pad_cells=0):
    """Rasterize polygon (list of (x,y) nm). Returns (x0,y0,mask) window indices."""
    xs = [p[0] for p in pts]
    ys = [p[1] for p in pts]
    ix0 = max(0, int((min(xs) - grid.x0) // grid.pitch) - 1 - pad_cells)
    ix1 = min(grid.W - 1, int((max(xs) - grid.x0) // grid.pitch) + 1 + pad_cells)
    iy0 = max(0, int((min(ys) - grid.y0) // grid.pitch) - 1 - pad_cells)
    iy1 = min(grid.H - 1, int((max(ys) - grid.y0) // grid.pitch) + 1 + pad_cells)
    if ix1 < ix0 or iy1 < iy0:
        return None
    X = grid.x0 + (np.arange(ix0, ix1 + 1) + 0.5) * grid.pitch
    Y = grid.y0 + (np.arange(iy0, iy1 + 1) + 0.5) * grid.pitch
    XX = X[None, :]
    YY = Y[:, None]
    inside = np.zeros((len(Y), len(X)), dtype=bool)
    n = len(pts)
    for i in range(n):
        x1, y1 = pts[i]
        x2, y2 = pts[(i + 1) % n]
        if y1 == y2:
            continue
        cond = ((y1 > YY) != (y2 > YY))
        with np.errstate(invalid='ignore', divide='ignore'):
            xint = (x2 - x1) * (YY - y1) / (y2 - y1) + x1
        inside ^= (cond & (XX < xint))
    return ix0, iy0, inside


def disk_mask(grid, cx, cy, r, pad_cells=0):
    ix0 = max(0, int((cx - r - grid.x0) // grid.pitch) - 1 - pad_cells)
    ix1 = min(grid.W - 1, int((cx + r - grid.x0) // grid.pitch) + 1 + pad_cells)
    iy0 = max(0, int((cy - r - grid.y0) // grid.pitch) - 1 - pad_cells)
    iy1 = min(grid.H - 1, int((cy + r - grid.y0) // grid.pitch) + 1 + pad_cells)
    if ix1 < ix0 or iy1 < iy0:
        return None
    X = grid.x0 + (np.arange(ix0, ix1 + 1) + 0.5) * grid.pitch - cx
    Y = grid.y0 + (np.arange(iy0, iy1 + 1) + 0.5) * grid.pitch - cy
    m = (X[None, :] ** 2 + Y[:, None] ** 2) <= float(r) ** 2
    return ix0, iy0, m


def seg_mask(grid, p, q, r, pad_cells=0):
    (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = p, q
    ix0 = max(0, int((min(x1, x2) - r - grid.x0) // grid.pitch) - 1 - pad_cells)
    ix1 = min(grid.W - 1, int((max(x1, x2) + r - grid.x0) // grid.pitch) + 1 + pad_cells)
    iy0 = max(0, int((min(y1, y2) - r - grid.y0) // grid.pitch) - 1 - pad_cells)
    iy1 = min(grid.H - 1, int((max(y1, y2) + r - grid.y0) // grid.pitch) + 1 + pad_cells)
    if ix1 < ix0 or iy1 < iy0:
        return None
    X = grid.x0 + (np.arange(ix0, ix1 + 1) + 0.5) * grid.pitch
    Y = grid.y0 + (np.arange(iy0, iy1 + 1) + 0.5) * grid.pitch
    px = X[None, :] - x1
    py = Y[:, None] - y1
    vx, vy = float(x2 - x1), float(y2 - y1)
    L2 = vx * vx + vy * vy
    if L2 <= 0:
        d2 = px ** 2 + py ** 2
    else:
        t = np.clip((px * vx + py * vy) / L2, 0.0, 1.0)
        d2 = (px - t * vx) ** 2 + (py - t * vy) ** 2
    return ix0, iy0, d2 <= float(r) ** 2


# --------------------------------------------------------------- router ----

FAKE_NET = 30000


class Router:
    def __init__(self, board, path):
        self.board = board
        self.pro = load_project(path)
        self.dru_w, self.dru_skew = parse_dru(path)
        rules = (self.pro.get("board", {}).get("design_settings", {}) or {}).get("rules", {}) or {}
        self.min_clearance = int(round(rules.get("min_clearance", 0.0) * MM))
        self.min_track = int(round(rules.get("min_track_width", 0.2) * MM))
        self.min_via_dia = int(round(rules.get("min_via_diameter", 0.4) * MM))
        self.min_via_ann = int(round(rules.get("min_via_annular_width", 0.05) * MM))
        self.min_drill = int(round(rules.get("min_through_hole_diameter", 0.3) * MM))
        self.edge_cl = int(round(rules.get("min_copper_edge_clearance", 0.0) * MM))
        self.hole_cl = int(round(rules.get("min_hole_clearance", 0.0) * MM))
        self.h2h = int(round(rules.get("min_hole_to_hole", 0.25) * MM))
        ns = self.pro.get("net_settings", {}) or {}
        cls = ns.get("classes", []) or [{}]
        self.clearance = max([int(round((c.get("clearance", 0.2) or 0.2) * MM)) for c in cls] + [self.min_clearance])
        self.layers = list(board.GetEnabledLayers().CuStack())
        if len(self.layers) > 2:
            self.layers = [pcbnew.F_Cu, pcbnew.B_Cu]
        self.nlay = len(self.layers)
        self.lay_index = {l: i for i, l in enumerate(self.layers)}

        # via geometry: smallest legal
        drill = max(self.min_drill, int(0.3 * MM))
        dia = max(self.min_via_dia, drill + 2 * self.min_via_ann + 20000)
        self.via_drill = drill + 2000
        self.via_dia = dia + 2000

    # ---- net info
    def setup_nets(self):
        b = self.board
        self.nets = {}        # name -> id
        self.net_names = {}   # id -> name
        self.net_width = {}
        nid = 0
        pads_by_net = {}
        for fp in b.GetFootprints():
            for pad in fp.Pads():
                name = pad.GetNetname()
                if not name:
                    continue
                pads_by_net.setdefault(name, []).append(pad)
        for name in sorted(pads_by_net):
            if len(pads_by_net[name]) < 1:
                continue
            nid += 1
            self.nets[name] = nid
            self.net_names[nid] = name
            w = max(self.min_track, self.dru_w.get(name, 0))
            self.net_width[nid] = w + 1000
        self.pads_by_net = pads_by_net

    def setup_grid(self):
        b = self.board
        poly = pcbnew.SHAPE_POLY_SET()
        try:
            ok = b.GetBoardPolygonOutlines(poly)
        except Exception:
            ok = False
        bb = b.GetBoardEdgesBoundingBox()
        x0, y0 = bb.GetX(), bb.GetY()
        wnm, hnm = bb.GetWidth(), bb.GetHeight()
        if wnm <= 0 or hnm <= 0:
            bb = b.GetBoundingBox()
            x0, y0, wnm, hnm = bb.GetX(), bb.GetY(), bb.GetWidth(), bb.GetHeight()
        margin = int(0.6 * MM)
        x0 -= margin
        y0 -= margin
        wnm += 2 * margin
        hnm += 2 * margin
        area_mm2 = (wnm / MM) * (hnm / MM)
        pitch = max(0.05, math.sqrt(area_mm2 / 1.7e6))
        pitch = math.ceil(pitch * 200) / 200.0  # round to 0.005mm
        self.pitch_nm = pitch * MM
        W = int(wnm / self.pitch_nm) + 1
        H = int(hnm / self.pitch_nm) + 1
        self.grid = Grid(x0, y0, W, H, self.pitch_nm)
        self.W, self.H = W, H
        self.HW = W * H
        log("grid %dx%d pitch %.3fmm cells %d" % (W, H, pitch, W * H))
        # inside-outline mask
        inside = np.zeros((H, W), dtype=bool)
        if ok and poly.OutlineCount() > 0:
            for oi in range(poly.OutlineCount()):
                o = poly.Outline(oi)
                pts = [(o.CPoint(i).x, o.CPoint(i).y) for i in range(o.PointCount())]
                res = poly_mask(self.grid, pts)
                if res:
                    ax, ay, m = res
                    inside[ay:ay + m.shape[0], ax:ax + m.shape[1]] |= m
            for oi in range(poly.OutlineCount()):
                o = poly.Outline(oi)
                for hi in range(poly.HoleCount(oi)):
                    hpoly = poly.Hole(oi, hi)
                    pts = [(hpoly.CPoint(i).x, hpoly.CPoint(i).y) for i in range(hpoly.PointCount())]
                    res = poly_mask(self.grid, pts)
                    if res:
                        ax, ay, m = res
                        inside[ay:ay + m.shape[0], ax:ax + m.shape[1]] &= ~m
        if inside.sum() < 0.05 * H * W:
            inside[:, :] = True
            inside[0, :] = False
            inside[-1, :] = False
            inside[:, 0] = False
            inside[:, -1] = False
        self.inside = inside

    # ---- obstacle buckets
    def bucket_for(self, halfw):
        rc = int(math.ceil((self.clearance + halfw) / self.pitch_nm - 1e-9))
        re_ = int(math.ceil((self.edge_cl + halfw) / self.pitch_nm - 1e-9))
        key = (rc, re_)
        if key not in self.buckets:
            n1 = [np.zeros((self.H, self.W), dtype=np.int16) for _ in range(self.nlay)]
            n2 = [np.zeros((self.H, self.W), dtype=np.int16) for _ in range(self.nlay)]
            ov = [np.zeros((self.H, self.W), dtype=bool) for _ in range(self.nlay)]
            outside = ~np.ascontiguousarray(dilate_disk(~self.inside, re_) == False)
            self.buckets[key] = dict(rc=rc, n1=n1, n2=n2, ov=ov, outside=outside)
            self.bucket_order.append(key)
        return self.buckets[key]

    def add_obstacle(self, layer_ids, win, netid):
        """win = (ix0, iy0, mask) of actual copper."""
        if win is None:
            return
        ax, ay, m = win
        if not m.any():
            return
        h, w = m.shape
        for key in self.bucket_order:
            bk = self.buckets[key]
            r = bk['rc']
            # pad window by r
            px0 = max(0, ax - r)
            py0 = max(0, ay - r)
            px1 = min(self.W, ax + w + r)
            py1 = min(self.H, ay + h + r)
            big = np.zeros((py1 - py0, px1 - px0), dtype=bool)
            big[ay - py0:ay - py0 + h, ax - px0:ax - px0 + w] = m
            d = dilate_disk(big, r)
            for li in layer_ids:
                s1 = bk['n1'][li][py0:py1, px0:px1]
                s2 = bk['n2'][li][py0:py1, px0:px1]
                so = bk['ov'][li][py0:py1, px0:px1]
                a = d & (s1 == 0)
                s1[a] = netid
                nd = d & (s1 != netid)
                a2 = nd & (s2 == 0)
                s2[a2] = netid
                so |= nd & (s2 != netid)

    def rasterize_pads(self):
        b = self.board
        self.occ = [np.zeros((self.H, self.W), dtype=np.int16) for _ in range(self.nlay)]
        self.pad_cells = {}
        items = []
        for fp in b.GetFootprints():
            for pad in fp.Pads():
                name = pad.GetNetname()
                nid = self.nets.get(name, FAKE_NET)
                lset = set(pad.GetLayerSet().CuStack())
                lids = [self.lay_index[l] for l in self.layers if l in lset]
                drill = max(pad.GetDrillSizeX(), pad.GetDrillSizeY())
                if drill > 0:
                    lids = list(range(self.nlay))
                if not lids:
                    continue
                items.append((pad, nid, lids, drill))
        for pad, nid, lids, drill in items:
            wins = []
            try:
                lay = self.layers[lids[0]]
                ep = pad.GetEffectivePolygon(lay)
                for oi in range(ep.OutlineCount()):
                    o = ep.Outline(oi)
                    pts = [(o.CPoint(i).x, o.CPoint(i).y) for i in range(o.PointCount())]
                    if len(pts) >= 3:
                        wins.append(poly_mask(self.grid, pts))
            except Exception:
                bb = pad.GetBoundingBox()
                pts = [(bb.GetX(), bb.GetY()), (bb.GetRight(), bb.GetY()),
                       (bb.GetRight(), bb.GetBottom()), (bb.GetX(), bb.GetBottom())]
                wins.append(poly_mask(self.grid, pts))
            if drill > 0:
                extra = max(0, self.hole_cl - self.clearance)
                p = pad.GetPosition()
                wins.append(disk_mask(self.grid, p.x, p.y, drill / 2.0 + extra))
            for win in wins:
                if win is None:
                    continue
                ax, ay, m = win
                for li in lids:
                    sub = self.occ[li][ay:ay + m.shape[0], ax:ax + m.shape[1]]
                    sub[m & (sub == 0)] = nid
                self.add_obstacle(lids, win, nid)
            if nid != FAKE_NET:
                key = (nid, pad.GetPosition().x, pad.GetPosition().y)
                cells = set()
                for win in wins[:1]:
                    if win is None:
                        continue
                    ax, ay, m = win
                    ys, xs = np.nonzero(m)
                    for yy, xx in zip(ys, xs):
                        cells.add((int(ay + yy), int(ax + xx)))
                if not cells:
                    p = pad.GetPosition()
                    cx, cy = self.grid.to_cell(p.x, p.y)
                    cells.add((cy, cx))
                self.pad_cells.setdefault(nid, []).append((cells, lids, pad))
        # drilled holes with no net / board edge handled by outside mask

    # ---- passability
    def passable_for(self, nid, halfw):
        bk = self.bucket_for(halfw)
        out = []
        for li in range(self.nlay):
            blocked = bk['ov'][li] | bk['outside']
            n1 = bk['n1'][li]
            n2 = bk['n2'][li]
            blocked |= (n1 != 0) & (n1 != nid)
            blocked |= (n2 != 0) & (n2 != nid)
            p = ~blocked
            p |= (self.occ[li] == nid)
            out.append(p)
        return out

    # ---- A*
    def astar(self, passable, via_ok, srcs, tgts, tcell, max_pop=400000, via_cost=160):
        W, HW, nlay = self.W, self.HW, self.nlay
        tx, ty = tcell
        wgt = 13
        push = heapq.heappush
        pop = heapq.heappop
        closed = bytearray(nlay * HW)
        g = {}
        par = {}
        heap = []
        for s in srcs:
            if s in g:
                continue
            g[s] = 0
            li = s // HW
            rem = s - li * HW
            y, x = divmod(rem, W)
            dx = abs(x - tx)
            dy = abs(y - ty)
            h = (10 * (dx + dy) - 6 * min(dx, dy)) * wgt // 10
            push(heap, (h, 0, s))
        dirs = ((1, 10), (-1, 10), (W, 10), (-W, 10), (W + 1, 14), (W - 1, 14), (-W + 1, 14), (-W - 1, 14))
        pops = 0
        found = None
        while heap:
            f, gc, u = pop(heap)
            if closed[u]:
                continue
            closed[u] = 1
            pops += 1
            if u in tgts:
                found = u
                break
            if pops > max_pop:
                break
            li = u // HW
            base = li * HW
            rem = u - base
            y, x = divmod(rem, W)
            for d, c in dirs:
                v = u + d
                if closed[v] or not passable[v]:
                    continue
                ng = gc + c
                old = g.get(v)
                if old is not None and old <= ng:
                    continue
                g[v] = ng
                par[v] = u
                vy, vx = divmod(v - base, W)
                dx = abs(vx - tx)
                dy = abs(vy - ty)
                h = (10 * (dx + dy) - 6 * (dx if dx < dy else dy)) * wgt // 10
                push(heap, (ng + h, ng, v))
            if nlay > 1 and via_ok[rem]:
                v = rem if li else rem + HW
                if not closed[v] and passable[v]:
                    ng = gc + via_cost
                    old = g.get(v)
                    if old is None or old > ng:
                        g[v] = ng
                        par[v] = u
                        dx = abs(x - tx)
                        dy = abs(y - ty)
                        h = (10 * (dx + dy) - 6 * (dx if dx < dy else dy)) * wgt // 10
